scoring_justification: Checker extracts min ΔE_ads per fragment from agent CSV and compares to paper-reported best values with tolerance; also checks S/D values directly. All gold is inline.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference best adsorption energies and hole-electron metrics from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text Fig. 6a and Supplementary Fig. 17-19; solve.sh derived constants
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: best ΔE_ads: PY-DHBD -8.96, PY-BPY -6.72, PY-BP -5.83 kcal/mol; S: 0.53/0.53/0.27; D: 1.27/0.00/0.55 Å
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values taken directly from the paper's reported numbers and the reference oracle's hardcoded artifacts that match the paper.

outputs.description: Adsorption energies of PtCl6^2- on PY-DHBD-COF, PY-BPY-COF, and PY-BP-COF fragment models at three binding sites each. The row with the most negative DeltaE_ads per Fragment is the best site.
Hole-electron overlap integral S and centroid distance D for the S1 excited state of each COF fragment.

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares the most negative adsorption energy per fragment and the S/D values against hidden reference values. Meeting or exceeding the reference accuracy (i.e., more negative adsorption or stronger hole-electron separation) earns full credit.
